observations: Every tested blockwise bound dominated the actual tail.
The singleton endpoint never exceeded the one-block bound.
At K=3, dyadic blocking increased certificates from 11177 to 11384.
At K=3, singleton blocking increased certificates from 11177 to 11521.
Singleton blocking covers about 72.76 percent of prime-positive channels in the finite benchmark.
No global Goldbach, asymptotic, or novelty claim is made.
